resumen_global: The audio depicts a rapidly deteriorating social gathering characterized by extreme awkwardness and toxic interpersonal dynamics. It moves from forced formality (Neutral/Surprise) to psychological warfare (Disgust), culminating in a manic outburst (Anger) triggered by a game of charades. The protagonist, Michael, oscillates between desperate people-pleasing and explosive frustration, while the guests attempt to escape the discomfort.

timeline.descripcion: The party begins with an awkward toast and uncomfortable music. Jan displays narcissistic behavior while the guests cringe.
Jim invents a fake emergency to leave. Michael realizes he is being abandoned with Jan and begs them to stay.
During charades, Jim intentionally sabotages Michael's turn. Michael's frustration boils over into screaming anger.
A hard cut to the mundane sounds of the workplace, contrasting with the chaos of the party.
